name: Thomas J. Wilson
background_rationale: Built his early career in corporate finance at Amoco and M&A at Dean Witter, then joined Allstate as CFO before running its financial and protection businesses.

notable.summary: Agreed to buy online insurer Esurance and rate-comparison site Answer Financial for about $1 billion to target consumers who want to buy insurance online.
Agreed to acquire consumer electronics and appliance protection plan provider SquareTrade for $1.4 billion.
Announced a roughly $4 billion acquisition of National General, which closed in January 2021 and expanded Allstate's independent-agent personal lines business.
Allstate completed the sale of its life insurance and annuity businesses, narrowing its focus to property-liability and protection products.

personal_story.hook: Before running Allstate, Tom Wilson spent 15 years in oil-company finance, Wall Street M&A and strategy at Sears.
personal_story.summary: Wilson grew up in St. Clair Shores, Michigan, and graduated from Lake Shore High School in 1975. He earned a business degree at the University of Michigan and an MBA from Northwestern's Kellogg School in 1980. He worked in finance at Amoco, then ran mergers and acquisitions at Dean Witter Reynolds, before moving to Sears as head of strategy. He has said he found his personal purpose, helping others achieve meaning and success, early in his career at Sears. He joined Allstate, then a Sears subsidiary, as CFO in 1995 and rose through its life and property businesses to CEO in 2007.

quote.text: Leading is knowing what your purpose is. If you choose to lead, you can make a difference.
quote.context: Talk to Kellogg School of Management students, 2009
